name: Serena Shigar Fort
area: Shigar village (~30 km / 45 min from Skardu)
highlight: Restored 17th-century Raja's fort run as an Aga Khan heritage hotel, with apricot gardens against the Karakoram
pros: Genuine 400-year-old fort architecture, beautifully preserved
Excellent food and fresh apricots from the garden
Friendly, attentive staff and serene location
cons: It's in Shigar, not Skardu town, so you trade convenience for atmosphere
No AC/TV and patchy in-room internet
take: The most atmospheric stay in the region and the clear top pick for a splurge, as long as you're happy to be based outside Skardu town.

name: Arish Luxury Suites
highlight: Skardu's best-reviewed modern luxury hotel: spacious, elegant rooms and strong food
pros: Very spacious, elegantly decorated rooms with large bathrooms
Exceptional staff who arrange tours and drivers
Tasty, varied breakfast and dinner
cons: Premium pricing for Skardu
Books out fast in the July-August peak
take: If you want polished modern luxury inside Skardu itself rather than a heritage fort, this is the standout, with a 5/5 Tripadvisor rank of #4 to match.

name: Shangrila Resort Skardu
area: Lower Kachura Lake (~20 km / 35 min from Skardu)
highlight: Pakistan's most photographed resort, on the heart-shaped Lower Kachura Lake with the famous grounded-aircraft restaurant
pros: Iconic, genuinely spectacular lakeside setting
The aeroplane restaurant and lake views are one-of-a-kind
Established (1983) and reliably operating
cons: Widely seen as overpriced for the dated rooms and patchy service
Ranks low (#37 of 44) on Tripadvisor despite the fame
take: Go for the unbeatable scenery and the experience, not the rooms; many find a day visit or meal better value than an overnight.

name: Hotel Mountain Lodge Skardu
area: Hillside above Skardu valley (out of town)
highlight: Hillside perch with some of the best valley views in Skardu, quiet and away from town noise
pros: Elevated position gives sweeping sunrise/sunset valley views
Clean, well-run with polite staff and its own restaurant
Free airport shuttle and parking
cons: Out-of-town location means you need transport for the bazaar
Ranks mid-pack (#29) on Tripadvisor
take: The pick for travellers who prize the view and quiet over being walkable to town; reliable mid-range comfort.

name: Hotel One Skardu
highlight: Consistent, business-grade chain reliability and the #1 Tripadvisor rank in Skardu
pros: Dependable, standardised rooms and service (part of a known PC chain)
Friendly staff, good food and included breakfast
Convenient airport location
cons: Only ~12 rooms, so it fills quickly
Functional rather than scenic; views aren't the draw
take: The safe, no-surprises mid-range choice and currently Tripadvisor's #1 in Skardu, best if you value consistency over character.

name: Byarsa Hotel Skardu
highlight: Stylish newer hotel with a garden and terrace, strong on design and breakfast
pros: Beautifully designed, modern rooms (some with mountain views)
Delicious, varied breakfast praised by guests
Garden, terrace and friendly staff
cons: Some mixed reviews on staff/policies across platforms
Booking score (8.8) cited is the couples rating
take: A good-looking, well-reviewed modern option that punches above typical Skardu mid-range stays on design and food.

name: Hotel Mashabrum
highlight: One of Skardu's longest-running hotels, walkable to the main bazaar and Kharpocho Fort
pros: Genuinely central; walk to the bazaar and Kharpocho Fort
Spacious rooms with private balconies
Helpful staff and an established track record
cons: Food quality gets mixed reviews
Decor is dated/modest rather than stylish
take: The pick if you want to be right in town and walk everywhere; a dependable old-hand hotel rather than a stylish one.

name: Hotel Himalaya Skardu
highlight: Warm, family-run feel with a garden and Karakoram/Himalaya views
pros: Friendly, cooperative staff and comfortable rooms
Beautiful garden and mountain views
Well located for Skardu's main sights
cons: Small review count, so the rating is less robust
Specialty lodging, so fewer hotel-grade amenities
take: A pleasant, personable guesthouse-style stay; one reviewer rated it above Skardu's 5-star option, though sample sizes are small.

name: K2 Hotel by Greenpak
highlight: Historic expedition base with an on-site K2/Karakoram museum and great terrace views
pros: Iconic mountaineering history and a genuine K2 museum on site
Fantastic terrace and garden views
Long-established budget base for expeditions
cons: Rooms and bathrooms are dated and basic; some harsh reviews
Standards are inconsistent
take: Choose it for the mountaineering heritage, views and price, not for room comfort; a budget pick with character.

name: Baltistan Continental Hotel
highlight: Budget-friendly hotel with an in-house antique museum and buffet dining
pros: Good-value pricing with breakfast/dinner buffets
In-house antique museum and mountain-view terrace rooms
Convenient base for exploring the city
cons: Mixed reviews: some report congested rooms and unclean washrooms
Food quality is hit-or-miss
take: A serviceable budget choice with a bit of character; manage expectations on cleanliness and ask to see the room first.
